a2-n-stockwerk: Your friend lives three flights of stairs above the entrance of a block of flats, and there is no lift.
The department store has five of these stacked on top of each other, and the shoe section is on the second one.
A skyscraper has forty of them. Which word means 'floor' or 'storey' of a building?
a2-n-basketball: Two teams run up and down a hall and throw an orange ball through a hoop with a net.
In sports class players bounce a ball and try to score through a high ring.
Your tall friend plays for a team and wants to be like the American stars. Which word means 'basketball'?
a2-n-mantel: It is snowing. You put on a long warm piece of clothing over your sweater before you leave.
In the restaurant you hand your outer garment to the staff at the cloakroom.
In winter men and women wear a long warm one over their clothes. Which word means 'coat'?
a2-adj-bequem: You sit down in a big soft armchair and feel relaxed, with no pain in your back.
Your new shoes do not hurt at all and you could walk all day in them.
The sofa is not hard or narrow; you could sleep on it. Which word means 'comfortable'?
a2-v-setzen: A mother lifts her toddler and puts him down onto the chair so that he sits.
In writing, you add a small mark between two parts of a sentence. What do you do with the comma?
At the start of the year you decide on a goal for yourself and put it down on paper.
a2-adv-endlich: You waited at the bus stop for forty minutes and now the bus arrives. You sigh with relief.
After years of studying you receive your diploma. You feel relieved after a long wait.
Your friend comes very late. After a long time of waiting you say what? Which adverb means 'at last'?
a2-n-keller: You go down the stairs to the dark room under the house to fetch a bottle of wine and old boxes.
In your building the bikes and the washing machine are kept in the lowest part, below the ground floor.
During a storm the family goes to the room below the house to be safe. Which word means 'cellar'?
a2-n-strand: On holiday you lie on the warm sand next to the sea and build a sandcastle.
You swim in the sea and then dry yourself on a towel on the soft sand by the water.
Families with umbrellas and buckets spend summer days here by the sea. Which word means 'beach'?
a2-v-markieren: In your textbook you use a yellow pen to colour the important sentences.
On a map you draw a cross to show where the hotel is.
The teacher asks you to put a tick next to the correct answers. Which verb means 'to mark'?
a2-n-verkehrsmittel: A tourist asks you: bus, tram, train or bike? What do you call all these ways of getting around the city?
Your town wants fewer cars, so people should use buses, trains and bicycles instead.
You want to get from the airport to the city centre and ask what is the best one: train, taxi or bus. Which word covers all of them?
a2-adj-haesslich: You see a building made of grey concrete with broken windows, and nobody likes how it looks.
The dress is torn and the colours do not match. Your friend says it looks awful.
In the fairy tale the witch has a crooked nose and warts. Which word means 'ugly'?
a2-n-note: At the end of term you get a number from 1 to 6 for your test.
On sheet music each little black dot on the lines shows a tone that you should play.
Your teacher gave you a 2 for your essay. Which word means 'grade' or 'mark'?
a2-adv-wahrscheinlich: The sky is dark and you hear thunder. You say it will rain, though you are not completely sure.
Your friend asks if you will come to the party. You are likely to come but it is not certain.
The weather report gives an eighty percent chance of rain. Which adverb means 'probably'?
a2-v-teilen: You have one big pizza and two people, so you cut it in half and each person takes one part.
You have a big chocolate bar and give some to your friends so everyone has some.
In maths you calculate twelve by three. Which verb means 'to divide'?
a2-n-interview: A journalist asks a famous actress many questions about her new film for a magazine.
You go to a company, sit with the manager and answer questions about your skills for a job.
On TV a reporter talks with a football coach after the match. Which word means 'interview'?
a2-n-pizza: In an Italian restaurant you order a round flat bread with tomato sauce and cheese.
A delivery man brings a flat box with melted cheese to your door.
You cut the round Italian dish into eight triangular slices. Which word means 'pizza'?
a2-adj-blond: The little girl has hair as light as straw and as yellow as the sun.
Your friend dyed her dark hair a very light yellow colour.
On a form you must write your hair colour and yours is light yellow. Which word means 'blond'?
a2-n-nachbarin: The woman who lives in the flat next to yours waters your plants while you are away.
You borrow sugar from the woman who lives next door.
Who is the woman living in the house next to yours? Which word means 'neighbour (female)'?
a2-v-klappen: Your plan was difficult, but everything went exactly as you hoped.
Your friend asks: 'Did you find a flat?' You say: 'I hoped to, but it did not succeed.'
You say 'I hope everything goes as planned tomorrow.' Which verb means 'to work out'?
a2-n-hamburger: At a fast-food restaurant you eat a round bread bun with a meat patty, salad and sauce.
At a barbecue the father puts a flat patty of minced meat between two halves of a bun.
You order a round sandwich with beef at a fast-food place. Which word means 'hamburger'?
a2-n-club: On Saturday night you dance to loud music with friends until 3 a.m. in a place with a DJ.
You join a group of people who meet every week to play football together and pay a small fee.
Your sister is a member of a group that meets to play tennis. Which word means 'club'?
a2-adj-fett: The doctor warns you not to eat too much food that has lots of oil in it, like chips and sausages.
In your text you want a word to stand out, so you write it with thick dark letters.
The meat has a thick white layer of oil on it. Which word means 'fatty'?
a2-adv-besonders: You like all of your presents, but one makes you extremely happy: you like it a lot more than the others.
The teacher says: 'Pay attention in particular to the last page.'
All the food was good, but the cake was extra good. Which adverb means 'especially'?
a2-v-sich-verabreden: You call a friend and agree to meet on Saturday at 3 p.m. in front of the cinema.
You chat with someone you like and agree to go out for dinner together.
You and a colleague fix a time and place for lunch next week. Which verb means 'to arrange to meet'?
a2-n-reihe: In the cinema your seats are in the third horizontal group of seats counting from the front.
The children stand next to each other, side by side, before they enter the classroom.
A TV channel shows several films about the same detective: part one, part two, part three. Which word means 'series'?
a2-n-kultur: In every country people have their own food, music, customs and festivals. All this together is what?
You travel to Japan and learn how people live, greet each other and celebrate there.
The city has theatres, museums and concerts for visitors. Which word means 'culture'?
a2-v-verlieren: You search your pockets and your key is not there. You cannot find it anywhere.
Your football team scores one goal but the other team scores three, so you finish behind.
You played chess and the other person won. Which verb means what happened to you?
a2-n-kirche: On Sunday morning the bells ring and people go to a large building with a tower to pray.
A couple gets married in a big old building with coloured windows and an organ.
In the middle of the village there is a tall building with a cross on top. Which word means 'church'?
a2-adj-beliebt: Everyone in your class likes the teacher and she always gets invited to parties.
That song is played on the radio all day and millions of people love it.
The café is always full because so many people like it. Which word means 'popular'?
a2-n-pruefer: At the driving test a man sits next to you and judges how you drive.
At the oral exam the man at the table asks you questions and writes down your grade.
A man from the company checks if the machine is safe. Which word means 'examiner' (male)?
a2-adv-nirgends: You look for your glasses in the kitchen, the bedroom, the bathroom and the car. They are not in any of these places.
You want a hotel room in July, but all hotels are full. There is not a free room in any place.
Your friend asks where the cat is. You looked everywhere. Which adverb means 'nowhere'?
a2-n-ball: Children kick a round object across the grass in the park.
In a tennis game you hit the small yellow round object over the net.
A dog runs to fetch the round toy you throw. Which word means 'ball'?
a2-v-vorbereiten: The exam is next week, so you study and practise every evening to be ready.
Guests are coming tonight. You chop vegetables and set the table beforehand.
The teacher says: 'Get ready for tomorrow's lesson.' Which verb means 'to prepare'?
a2-n-schauspieler: A man in a film plays a policeman who chases a thief.
At the theatre a man stands on stage in a costume and speaks the lines of the play.
Your uncle is a man who plays roles in TV series. Which word means 'actor'?
a2-adj-lila: The colour of a ripe plum or of lavender: a mix of blue and red.
Your friend paints her nails with a colour between pink and blue.
At sunset the sky turns a colour between red and blue. Which word means 'purple'?
a2-n-band: Four young men play guitar, bass and drums at a concert in a club.
Your cousin sings in a group with three friends and they practise in the garage every Friday.
At a wedding a group of musicians plays dance music. Which word means 'band'?
a2-v-eintragen: At the hotel reception you write your name and address on the form.
You have a new appointment and write it into your calendar.
You put your name on the list for the course. Which verb means 'to register'?
a2-n-kellner: In the restaurant a man in a black waistcoat brings your soup.
You call over the man who takes orders and brings food, and ask him for the bill.
Who serves you at the table in a restaurant? Which word means 'waiter'?
a2-n-zirkus: Children watch clowns, acrobats and lions in a big tent.
A travelling show arrives in town with trapeze artists and a man who juggles.
You buy tickets for a big tent show with acrobats and clowns. Which word means 'circus'?
a2-adj-schwierig: The maths exercise is so tough that nobody in the class can solve it.
Learning to speak a new language is not easy at first.
Your grandfather finds the touchscreen phone hard to use. Which word means 'difficult'?
a2-adv-zweitens: In a speech you give reasons: 'First, it is cheap. And in second place, it is fast.' Which adverb introduces the second reason?
You explain why you like your job: firstly the colleagues, and then, as your next point, the salary.
In a debate you list your points one after the other. Which adverb means 'secondly'?
a2-v-zurueckgeben: You borrowed a book from a friend and now you take it back to her.
The jacket does not fit, so you take it back to the shop and ask for your money.
The cashier gave you too much change, so you hand the extra money back. Which verb means 'to give back'?
a2-n-parfuem: Before going out you spray a nice-smelling liquid on your neck.
For her birthday you give your mother a small glass bottle with a flowery scent.
In the shop you test different scents on small paper strips. Which word means 'perfume'?
a2-n-ziel: You get on the plane to Rome. Rome is the place where your trip ends.
This year you want to learn German up to level B1. That is what you want to reach.
The taxi driver asks where you want to go. You name the place you want to reach. Which word means 'destination'?
a2-n-ehepartner: On the form you must write the name of the person you are married to.
At the company party employees may bring the person they are married to.
A husband or a wife is the person you are married to. Which word means 'spouse'?
a2-adj-dringend: The doctor says you must come at once. It cannot wait.
The email is marked with a red flag: it must be answered now, no delay possible.
The message says 'Call me back immediately, it is very important and cannot wait.' Which word means 'urgent'?
a2-v-surfen: On the internet you click from page to page looking for information.
On holiday you stand on a board on big waves in the sea.
On a lake you stand on a board with a sail and the wind pushes you across the water.
a2-n-t-shirt: In summer you wear a light top with short sleeves and no buttons.
At the concert you buy a cotton top with the band's name printed on it.
You put on a short-sleeved cotton top for sport. Which word means 'T-shirt'?
a2-n-creme: In winter your hands are dry, so you rub a soft white lotion on them.
At the dessert counter there is a sweet, soft, whipped topping to put on the cake.
At the pharmacy you buy a tube for your sunburned skin. Which word means 'cream'?
a2-adv-vorwaerts: In the car you shift into the gear that moves you in the direction you are facing, not backwards.
The coach shouts to the team: 'Move ahead, towards the goal!'
A crab walks sideways, but you walk toward the front. Which adverb means 'forwards'?
a2-v-reden: Your friend speaks to you for an hour on the phone about her problems.
In the meeting people take turns to say their opinion.
Your mum says: 'Please say something to me, do not stay silent.' Which verb means 'to talk'?
a2-n-rock: A woman wears a knee-length piece of clothing from the waist down, with no legs, to the office.
Elvis and the Rolling Stones played this style of music with loud guitars and a fast drummer.
In a clothes shop you try on a short pleated garment that is not trousers. Which word means 'skirt'?
a2-adj-intelligent: Your classmate solves every puzzle in seconds and learns very quickly.
A girl at school understands complex ideas fast and always asks clever questions.
The professor is very clever and quick to understand things. Which word means 'intelligent'?
a2-n-anzug: For a job interview you put on a jacket and matching trousers, with a tie.
The groom wears a black outfit with a jacket and trousers at his wedding.
A businessman wears a formal jacket and trousers in the same fabric. Which word means 'suit'?
a2-v-passieren: You hear a loud crash outside. You ask your neighbour: 'What has ...?'
Your friend looks pale. You ask what occurred.
The police ask: 'Tell us what ... at the crossing.' Which verb means 'to happen'?
a2-n-abitur: After twelve or thirteen years at school young people in Germany take exams that allow them to go to university.
Your cousin is nervous because she has to pass her final secondary school exams next month.
Which word means the school leaving exam, similar to A levels?
a2-n-theater: In the evening you put on nice clothes and go to a big building where actors perform plays on a stage.
Your class goes to a place with a curtain, rows of seats and a stage to watch a play.
You buy tickets for a play at a building with a stage. Which word means 'theatre'?
a2-adj-schrecklich: The food in the restaurant tasted so bad that you could not eat it. It was the worst meal ever.
There was a very sad accident on the motorway with many injured people. It shocked everyone.
The film was so bad that you left after ten minutes. Which word means 'terrible'?
a2-adv-hoffentlich: You say you wish that it does not rain tomorrow. Which adverb begins this wish?
Your friend takes an exam. You say you wish she passes.
You are waiting for good news and want to say 'I wish it will be good'. Which adverb means 'hopefully'?
a2-n-landschaft: From the train window you look at hills, fields and a river.
A painter paints the mountains and lakes of the area around him.
A tourist photographs the green hills and valleys around the village. Which word means 'landscape'?
a2-v-mitspielen: Children are playing football in the park. You ask if you can join them.
Your friends are in the middle of a card game and invite you to be one of the players.
In the garden the kids invite you into their game. Which verb means 'to join in a game'?
a2-n-see: The ship travels over the salty water for days with no land in sight.
Waves crash on the shore and you smell salt and hear seagulls.
Fishermen sail out onto the open salt water of the ocean. Which word means 'sea'?
a2-n-bluse: A woman wears a light, thin top with buttons and a collar to the office.
You iron a silk top with buttons for a girl before her interview.
In the shop you buy a smart top with buttons for a woman. Which word means 'blouse'?
a2-adj-einzeln: In the shop you can buy the cakes alone, not in a pack of six: one by one.
At the end of the field one tree stands by itself on the hill.
The teacher calls the students up one at a time. Which word means 'individual' or 'single'?
a2-v-bauen: A family puts up a house with bricks on a plot of land.
Children make a tower from wooden blocks.
A company puts up a new bridge over the river. Which verb means 'to build'?
a2-n-teller: You put spaghetti on a round flat dish and eat it with a fork.
After lunch you wash the round flat dishes and put them in the cupboard.
At dinner the waiter puts a round flat dish in front of you. Which word means 'plate'?
a2-n-ferien: School is closed for six weeks in summer and the students are free.
Your family travels to Spain for two weeks of free time with no work.
Children are looking forward to the long break from school. Which word means 'holiday'?
a2-adv-vorn: In the classroom you sit near the board, not at the back.
In the bus the driver is at the part nearest the road ahead and you want to sit there.
In a cinema you choose a seat close to the screen. Which adverb means 'at the front'?
a2-v-aendern: Your plan does not work, so you decide to make it different.
You cut and dye your hair because you want a new look.
The company decides to make the rules different from next month. Which verb means 'to change'?
a2-n-ermaessigung: At the museum students pay 5 euros instead of 10. What do students get?
At the cinema a sign says pensioners get a lower price. What is this lower price called?
The ticket shop offers 20 percent off for children. Which word means 'discount'?
a2-adj-echt: The handbag is made of leather from an animal, not of plastic.
You are not sure if the 50-euro note is a fake, so the shop checks that it is no forgery.
The painting is not a copy but made by the artist himself. Which word means 'genuine'?
a2-n-kreuzung: You drive and reach a place where two roads meet. The traffic light turns red.
The taxi driver says: 'Turn left at the next place where the roads cross.'
Four roads meet and there are traffic lights. Which word means 'crossroads'?
a2-n-tafel: The teacher writes with chalk on a big dark surface at the front of the classroom.
A student goes to the front and writes the solution with chalk for everyone to read.
In the old classroom there is a large dark board with a sponge. Which word means 'blackboard'?
a2-v-trainieren: Every evening an expert leads the football players in running and kicking exercises so that they become better.
You go to the gym to build muscles.
The swimmer prepares for the competition by swimming for two hours every morning. Which verb means 'to train'?
a2-n-rundgang: A guide leads visitors through the old castle, room by room.
On the school open day parents move through all the classrooms with a student.
At the start the manager shows you the factory, walking through each department. Which word means 'tour'?
a2-adj-praktisch: The bag has many pockets and a handle, so it is easy to use every day.
The new kitchen tool opens tins and bottles, so it is useful in daily life.
A folding bike is not fancy but very useful in the city. Which word means 'practical'?
a2-adv-heraus: The cat is inside the box. You call: 'Come ...!' meaning 'out', toward you.
A magician pulls a rabbit from a hat, from the inside toward you.
You tell your brother to come from his room to where you stand. Which word means 'out', in the direction of the speaker?
a2-n-schnee: In winter the roofs and streets are covered with white, soft, cold stuff and children throw balls of it.
You go skiing in the mountains on white powder.
White flakes fall from the sky in winter and cover everything. Which word means 'snow'?
a2-v-beantworten: A friend sends you a question by email and you write back with the information.
In the exam you write the solutions to the ten questions.
The teacher asks a question and a student gives the reply. Which verb means 'to answer'?
a2-n-neujahr: At midnight on 31 December there are fireworks. The next day everyone stays at home and the shops are closed.
The first day of the year is a holiday in many countries.
On 1 January you wish everybody a good year. Which word means 'New Year's Day'?
a2-n-kette: She wears a gold string with a pendant around her neck.
A bicycle moves forward because of the metal links that connect the pedals to the wheel.
A jeweller sells gold jewellery you wear around your neck. Which word means 'necklace' or 'chain'?
a2-adj-sauer: You bite into a lemon and your face twists.
The milk is old and tastes sharp.
Your brother took your bike without asking and you are really angry. Which word means 'angry' here?
a2-v-erreichen: After walking for hours you finally get to the top of the mountain.
You call your boss five times, but cannot get in contact with her.
With hard work you finally accomplish your goal. Which verb means 'to achieve'?
a2-n-sendung: You wait for the postman because a parcel from an online shop is on its way.
On TV a cooking show starts at 8 p.m.
A radio programme about music starts in five minutes. Which word means 'broadcast'?
a2-n-weihnachten: On 24 December families have a tree with lights and exchange presents.
In December markets sell hot spiced wine and gingerbread, and children wait for a man in a red coat.
In the shop the signs say that the holiday with presents and a tree is coming. Which word means 'Christmas'?
a2-adv-online: You shop on the internet and not in a shop.
You see a green dot next to your friend's name in the chat app, so he is connected to the internet.
The lesson does not take place in a classroom but through your computer. Which adverb means 'online'?
a2-n-tasse: You pour hot coffee into a small round container with a handle.
Your grandma has a big one with a flower pattern for her tea.
At breakfast you drink tea from a small porcelain container with a handle. Which word means 'cup'?
a2-adj-sportlich: Your friend plays tennis, swims and runs, and has strong muscles.
The car has a low shape and a fast engine, so it looks fast.
A woman is active and fit and loves exercise. Which word means 'sporty'?
a2-v-runterladen: You save a song from the internet onto your phone.
You get a PDF from a web page onto your laptop.
You take an app from the app store and put it on your phone. Which verb means 'to download'?
a2-n-antwortbogen: In a multiple-choice exam you tick boxes on a separate paper that is scanned later.
At the end of a survey in a magazine you get a paper where you tick your answers and send it back.
The teacher hands out a separate paper on which you mark your answers. Which word means 'answer sheet'?
a2-n-ostern: In spring children search for coloured eggs in the garden, and a bunny brings chocolate.
It is a spring holiday in March or April when people eat lamb or a sweet yeast bread and paint eggs.
In the shop the shelves are full of chocolate bunnies and eggs. Which word means 'Easter'?
a2-v-teilnehmen: You sign up for a marathon and run in it with a thousand others.
Your colleague goes to the meeting and joins the discussion.
More than 50 people are in the language course. Which verb means 'to participate'?
a2-n-angestellte: A man works for a company and gets a monthly salary, but he is not the boss.
In the office a man works for the firm and has a contract.
On the form you state your job situation: a man who works for a firm. Which word means 'employee' (male)?
a2-adj-eigen: You do not want to share a room any more. You want a room that belongs only to you.
A friend says he saw it with his personal eyes.
You would like to have a car that belongs only to you. Which word means 'own'?
a2-adv-mittags: At twelve o'clock many people eat their main meal. Which adverb says 'at noon'?
The sun is at its highest point and the canteen opens.
The shop is closed every day between twelve and two. Which adverb means 'at midday'?
a2-n-fruehjahr: It is the season when flowers start to bloom and days get longer after winter.
Birds return and trees get green leaves in March, April and May.
After winter comes this season, before summer. Which word means 'spring'?
a2-v-leihen: You have no book, so you ask the library to give you one for three weeks.
Your friend forgot her pen. You give her yours for class and she gives it back later.
You say to your friend: 'Could you ... me 10 euros until tomorrow?' Which verb means 'to lend'?
a2-n-zeugnis: At the end of the school year you get a paper with all your grades.
After working at a firm for five years your boss writes a document describing how you worked.
You must send a copy of your school papers with your job application. Which word means 'report' or 'certificate'?
a2-n-fahrplan: At the bus stop a poster shows the times each bus leaves.
You check an app to see when the next train leaves.
The train station has a big board with all departures. Which word means 'timetable'?
a2-adj-offen: The shop door is unlocked and the light is on, so you can go in.
A window is not closed and the wind blows in.
The sign on the door shows the shop is ready for customers. Which word means 'open'?
